title: Remote disk gate over-counts when install state is unknown; model panel disk split
description: A failed or short Pod status pre-check leaves statusResults empty, so the remote disk-full gate counts every dep (shared ones already on the volume included) and refuses installs that fit. Proven offline: H3-ref-shaped deps, 30GB free, check OK starts, check failed blocks at 46.3GB. Fix the gate to count only bytes known to be missing, and show total / on disk / to download in the model detail panel.
